summary: Iteration 77 - Verified 6 routing/filtering bug fixes (tasks assignee, restricted location leak, chat ghost users, multi-campus switcher, volunteer scheduler, calendar tasks) + admin-tier role guard. All 9 backend tests PASS (100%). Frontend flows verified: Comms uses /api/chat/users (not /api/members), Board card assignee picker excludes Guest/Parent/Member, Volunteer New Shift dialog has Linked Event field, Calendar has Task legend (blue).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/admin/users stores only single location_id (drops location_ids array from payload). Admin must PUT /api/admin/users/{id} with location_ids after creation to assign multiple campuses. Consider accepting location_ids directly in POST for better DX.

Calendar page: Task legend shows blue dot but no tasks appear in May 2026 view. Could not independently confirm task-event rendering because no tasks with due_date in current month exist in seed data. Main agent should create a task with a due_date and verify it renders on calendar with blue color and click-navigates to /boards?board=...&task=...

Comms New Conversation dialog: /api/chat/users is fetched at page mount (not on dialog open). This is correct behavior (cached), but means API call count does not increase when dialog opens. Verified no /api/members calls occur on Comms page.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ prefixed users/locations/members during tests — all cleaned up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 routing bugs fixed and validated. Backend: (1) /api/admin/users/directory returns only STAFF_ROLES (admin, system_admin, Executive Director, Adviser, Director, Manager, Leader, Coordinator, Staff, HR, Volunteer) scoped to active campus — include_all=true works only for sysadmins. (2) get_campus_filter in /app/backend/deps.py correctly excludes restricted sub-locations for non-admins unless in user's location_ids. Verified: a Manager assigned only to parent campus does NOT see members in restricted sub-locations. (3) PUT /api/user/active-campus now works for multi-campus non-admins: returns 400 for missing campus_id, 200 for campuses in user.location_ids, 403 for campuses outside assignment. (4) POST /api/admin/users has admin-tier role guard (only sysadmin can assign admin/system_admin/Executive Director); require_admin blocks non-admins entirely. Frontend verified visually: Comms uses chatApi.users(), Board card assignee excludes non-staff roles, Volunteer New Shift dialog shows Linked Event select. Calendar task rendering could not be visually confirmed due to no tasks with due_date in current month — recommend main agent add a dated task and visually verify.
